package_name_snapshot: Kerala Explorer — Classic Backwaters & Tea Trails

package_details_snapshot.name: Kerala Explorer — Classic Backwaters & Tea Trails
package_details_snapshot.tagline: Houseboat cruise, mist-clad Munnar tea hills, and authentic Kerala homestays
package_details_snapshot.mealPlan: Breakfast Included Daily + 1 Houseboat Full Dinner

itinerary.title: Kochi Arrival & Scenic Drive to Munnar Hills
activities: Airport/station pickup in private AC cab
Scenic waterfall stops along Neriamangalam route
Evening plantation resort check-in
itinerary.description: Warm welcome at Cochin International Airport (COK) or Ernakulam Junction. Enjoy a picturesque 4-hour drive climbing into the Western Ghats past Cheeyappara and Valara waterfalls. Check into your hillside cottage and relax with high-altitude fresh tea.

itinerary.title: Munnar Tea Gardens, Echo Point & Kundala Lake
activities: Morning visit to Echo Point & Kundala Lake
Tea museum & historic factory tasting walk
Sunset vantage point at Photo Point
itinerary.description: Wake up to misty green valleys. Explore Mattupetty Dam, Echo Point, and Kundala Lake. Visit an authentic colonial tea processing factory and understand the journey from leaf to cup.

itinerary.title: Munnar to Alleppey Houseboat Backwater Cruise
activities: Scenic transfer to Alleppey jetty
Check-in aboard traditional wooden houseboat
Freshly prepared candle-lit Kerala dinner under starry skies
itinerary.description: Descend the hills towards the tranquil backwaters of Alleppey. Board your traditional Kerala kettuvallam houseboat. Cruise through palm-fringed lagoons, paddy fields, and quiet canal hamlets while chef prepares fresh Karimeen fish curry and coconut rice.

itinerary.title: Morning Village Cruise & Departure via Kochi
activities: Morning calm backwater cruise
Optional Fort Kochi heritage stop
Drop-off at Cochin Airport / Railway Station
itinerary.description: Enjoy breakfast as morning prayers echo across the serene waterways. Disembark at 09:30 AM and transfer back to Kochi for heritage sightseeing in Fort Kochi (Chinese fishing nets) before your flight or train home.

exclusions: Airfare or Train tickets to and from Kochi / Ernakulam
Entry ticket fees at Eravikulam National Park and Mattupetty Dam (payable on spot)
Personal laundry, beverage mini-bar, and discretionary driver tips
Any additional meals or activities not listed in inclusions
inclusions: 3 Nights Handpicked Stays (2 Nights Munnar Hillside Cottage + 1 Night Alleppey Deluxe Houseboat)
Daily Fresh Mountain Breakfast & 1 Traditional Kerala Houseboat Dinner
Private AC Sedan Transfer for Airport/Station Pickup, Drop, and All Sightseeing
Guided Tea Plantation & Factory Walk with Tea Tasting Session
Scenic 3-Hour Alleppey Backwater Canal Cruise
All Tolls, Fuel, Parking Fees, and Experienced Chauffeur Allowances
package_details_snapshot.pickupDrop: Cochin International Airport (COK) or Ernakulam Railway Station
package_details_snapshot.description: Designed for travelers who want to experience the quintessential wonders of Kerala without unnecessary frills. From cool mountain breezes in Munnar to gentle drifting along the Vembanad backwaters, this tour balances essential sights with restful pauses.
